name: Why choose a professional for storm cleanup instead of doing it myself?

mainEntity.name: Why choose a professional for storm cleanup instead of doing it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional storm cleanup teams have specialized equipment and training to safely and effectively handle hazardous situations, such as structural instability, contaminated water, and heavy debris. Attempting DIY cleanup can pose risks of injury or lead to incomplete restoration, potentially resulting in secondary issues like mold. Professionals ensure proper disposal, thorough drying, and compliance with safety standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals have specialized equipment and training for safe and effective storm cleanup, reducing risks of injury or incomplete restoration that DIY methods might pose.
